capture.capture_method_note: Synthetic raw_rows representing realistic resolver-observed OTR/OFR yield pairs; expected_output produced by running the primitive against these rows.  Locks in regression behaviour pending replacement by live-DB capture via _capture.py once the resolver is deployed and the cash-bond playbook has ingested per-CUSIP yields.

time_series_spread.description: OTR/OFR yield spread for the US 10Y sovereign cash-bond slot (otr − ofr, in bps) over the displayed window.

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the US 10Y OTR/OFR yield spread vs its own trailing 252-trading-day window.

expected_output.methodology_note: Source: macro_data.otr_history (ADR 0003) JOIN macro_data.market_data_daily; OTR/OFR pair resolution per the on-the-run resolver (ADR 0007).  Forward-only ingest: pre-resolver OTR windows are NOT reconstructed — queries that pre-date the resolver's first run return an error envelope, never a fabricated spread.  Detection-date precision: a window's effective_from is the resolver's first confirmed observation, ~1-2 days after the true auction date at daily incremental cadence (TD #27); roll-day spread datapoints may correspondingly lag the auction.  OFR is defined as the bond from the SCD2 window IMMEDIATELY PRIOR to the window covering the trade date (LAG over effective_from); the slot's first-ever observed window has no prior bond and emits ofr_yield=None / spread=None (honest absence, not zero).  Bloomberg has no historical OTR-window screen; this primitive does not recompute what the source of record provides (P12).
